digest.component_or_area: store write lock ownership / staleness detection
propositions: On platforms without /proc (macOS), _process_start_time always returns None, making the recycled-pid discriminant in _mkdir_lock_is_stale unsatisfiable and causing locks held by dead processes with recycled pids to never be reclaimed

When current_start is None (unqualified liveness verdict), the ceiling backstop is now applied to reclaim orphaned locks, while genuinely-live owners with matching stamped and current start times are still never broken on a timer alone

The owner-identity and staleness cluster was refactored from lock.py into lock_owner.py to respect the 800-line module-size limit, with one-way dependency and all 54 test reference sites (12 patch-string, 42 attribute-access) repointed without re-export shim
A live pid whose start time differs from the stamp is still reclaimed immediately independent of age, preserving the recycled-pid detection for platforms with /proc
